chapter.verse: Himah taleh mite' lakah kamsang zuaute a pian mah bangin note' lakah zong hilhcian sya zuaute hong piang ding a, amaute a lei Topa Lianbel nangawn nialin a siahuai upkhialhna thute hong lutpih sim ding uh hi. Tua hangin amaumah in a manlangin siatna a tuahlawh ding uh ahi hi.
Mi tampi in tua mite' cilesa paktatna zui ding uh a, tua mite' hangin thumaan thutak lampi mindai ding hi.
Huaihamna hangin zuau thu tawh note hong metbawl ding uh hi. Sawtpi peka om amaute' thuak ding thukhenna a omkhong hilo a, amau' tuahkhak ding kisiatna a ihmu hilo hi.
A hang pen Pasian in vanmite a mawh uh ciangin map tuan lo-in lungzinna khauhual tawh hencipin thukhenna hun dong khumcip dingin Tartarus sungah khiasuk ahihleh,
tua bek hilo-in kihtakbei gamtatna tawh a kidim leitung ah tuicin a tunsak lai-in tanglai mihingte map lo-in dikna thu a tangko Noah leh midang sagihte bek siit ahihleh,
tua bek hilo-in kihtakbei misiate' tunga piang ding thu etsakna lim dingin Sodom leh Gomorrah khuapite gawtin vutlevai suaksakin beimangsak ahihleh,
tua bek hilo-in thukhun pualam mite' cilesa paktatna hangin nakpi-in a lunggim ahi midik Lot honkhia ahihleh,

(hih midikpa tua mite lakah a teen laitak a nini-in a muhkhak a zakkhak thukhun pampaih gamtatnate' hangin a thumaan ama' nunna kha zong gawttuak a bang den hi a, amah zong tua lakpan kihonkhia ahihleh,)
Topa in biakna hahkatte gentheihna sungpan bangci hotkhiat ding cih ahi zongin, midiklote thukhenna ni dong gawtna bangci tuahsak ding cih ahi zongin thei hi.
Midiklote cih ciangin a diakin a thanghuai cilesa lunggulhna a zul, ukna thu a thusim lote ahi uh hi. Tua mite kiphasakin amau' thu bek thu sa uh a, vanglian minphate kihta lo-in daisak ngam uh hi.
Vanmite ahihleh thahatna leh vangliatna ah ginazaw uh ahih hangin Topa' mai-ah hih mite zahko thukhenna bawl lo uh hi.

Himah taleh hih mite pen mat ding leh thah ding beka a piang, lungsim sunga suak bangbanga a gamta, khinkhaina neilo ganhingte tawh kibang uh a, a theih loh thute uh zahpih uh ahih manin tua ganhingte' siatna nam mah tawh kisia ding uh hi.

Amau' siattatna thaman dingin thusia mah tuakkik ding uh hi. Suntangpi-a nop-om pen nopsakna khatin la uh hi. No tawh pawi hong bawlkhop laitak mahun amau pen zuau gamtatna ah nuamsa uh a, note' adingin pawnsia leh beelmang tawh kibang uh hi.
A mittang uh angkawmna tawh kidimin mawhna bawl ding khawl theilo uh a, lungsim kip lo mite zolkhia uh hi. A lungtang uh huaihamna lamah zongsang khin hi. Haamsiatngah tate ahihzia uh!
Lampi maan pampaihin lampial khinta uh hi. Beor' tapa, siattatna pan thaman a ngah nuam Balaam' zawi zui uh hi.
Tua Balaam pen ama' palsatna hangin taai a thuak ahi hi. (A pau theilo vanpua gan, mihing' aw tawh hong paukhia-in kamsangpa' haitatna kham hi.)
Hih mite pen tui phullo tuinakte leh huihpi' mutkhiat meiilumte tawh kibang uh a, amau' adingin khuamial sahpi kikoihkhol hi.
A hang pen khiatna neilo kisialhna kamte pau uh a, khialhna sunga nungtate' kiangpan a suakta liamliam mite pen pumpi cilesa lunggulhna leh cilesa paktatna tawh zolkhia uh hi.
Tua mite in amaute' tungah suahtakna thu kamciam pia uh a, ahih hangin amau mahmah siatna sila ahi uh hi. Banghanghiam cihleh mihing pen amah a zo peuhpeuh ii sila a suak ahi hi.

A hang pen i Topa leh Honpa Jesu Khris theihna cingtaak tungtawnin leitung thanghuainate pan a suahtak khit uh ciangin tuate' sungah awkkikin tuate a lelh uhleh amau' omzia pen a masa sangin a nunung suksiazaw ding hi.

A hang pen diktatna lampi thu a cingtaakin theih khit nungah amau' tunga ki-apsawn thupiak siangtho pan a kiheikik uhleh tua thu a cingtaakin a thei ngeilo uh hi vet leh amau' ading hoihzaw lai ding hi.
“Ui in ama' luak mah nekik, vok zong a kisil khit ciangin buan lakah bualkik,” cih a thumaan paunak bangin a piang ahi hi.
